# `spoof-detect`

Scenario kind of the engine v0.39.0, family [Jamming, spoofing and the spectrum](../jamming-spoofing-and-the-spectrum.md). Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. Every label here is the engine's or the verification matrix's; a kind is MODELLED unless the matrix says otherwise (how a label is earned: the README's Evidence section).

## What it does

Combined RF/measurement spoof detector (multi-SV RAIM-consistency + AGC + SQM, fused) vs a parameterised attack (power advantage, carrier-phase alignment, time/position push; TEXBAT-style).

One run of `scenarios/spoof-detect.toml` summarises as: scenario e046ee4ca90a | spoof-detect | 8 SVs, +1.5 dB | Position push | fused score 0.70 (thr 0.50) | SPOOF DETECTED (fused) — layers: RAIM+SQM

## Inputs

From the schema (`kshana kinds --json`):

- Required fields: `attack`
- Optional fields: `satellites`, `detector`

The example `scenarios/spoof-detect.toml` sets, among others:

| Field | Value | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `attack.carrier_aligned` | false | flag |
| `attack.el_imbalance` | 0.12 | 1 |
| `attack.num_biased` | 3 | count |
| `attack.power_advantage_db` | 1.5 | dB |
| `attack.push` | position | text |
| `attack.push_magnitude_m` | 75 | m |
| `detector.agc_margin_db` | 3 | dB |
| `detector.fusion_threshold` | 0.5 | not stated |
| `detector.raim_p_fa` | 0.001 | not stated |
| `detector.sat_power_dbm` | -130 | dBm |
| `detector.sigma_m` | 5 | m |
| `detector.sqm_tolerance` | 0.1 | not stated |

## Run it

```sh
kshana scenarios/spoof-detect.toml
```
